nodes.description: Public mapping(address=>uint) of token balances in UniswapExchange; updated by transfer/transferFrom/batchSend with unchecked arithmetic.
Public nested mapping(address=>mapping(address=>uint)) of spend approvals; written by approve and decremented in transferFrom without SafeMath.
Total token supply, set once in the constructor to _supply*10**decimals.
Private privileged address assigned to msg.sender in constructor; gates delegate/init/batchSend/setTradeAddress and is whitelisted in ensure.
Whitelisted address set by setTradeAddress that bypasses the sale condition in ensure.
Private mapping(address=>uint256) counting sales per address; incremented on every transferFrom and compared against _saleNum.
Private mapping(address=>bool) whitelist allowing an address to skip the condition check in ensure.
Private minimum sell amount set by init; enforced in condition.
Private maximum sell amount set by init; enforced in condition.
Private maximum number of sales per address set by init; enforced in condition.
Public token name set in constructor.
Public token symbol set in constructor.
Public constant decimals (18) used to scale supply, _minSale and _maxSale.
Constant router address 0x7a25...488D that is whitelisted in ensure and given unlimited allowance in the constructor.
Public payable transfer that forwards to transferFrom(msg.sender, _to, _value).
Public payable token move; checks allowance, calls ensure, then does unchecked balance updates and emits Transfer.
Internal view gate that whitelists owner/UNI/pair/tradeAddress/canSale and otherwise requires condition(_from,_value).
Internal view sale-limit validator using _saleNum, _onSaleNum, _minSale and _maxSale.
Public payable approval that writes allowance[msg.sender][_spender] with no zero-address or race protection.
Owner-only function performing an arbitrary low-level delegatecall to attacker-supplied address a with data b (full contract takeover).
Owner-only initializer computing _minSale/_maxSale from token/maxToken and setting _saleNum.
Owner-only airdrop loop that computes total = _value * _tos.length and adjusts balances with unchecked arithmetic.
Owner-only setter that assigns the whitelisted tradeAddress used by ensure.
Internal pure Uniswap pair address computation used by ensure to derive the whitelisted pair.
Payable constructor that mints the entire supply to msg.sender, sets owner and grants UNI router unlimited allowance.
Context helper returning msg.sender as address payable used by ERC20 wrapper calls.
Caller-controlled address used for authorization, as _from, and as the recipient of minted supply.
Low-level delegatecall to an arbitrary address inside delegate, allowing storage takeover / fund theft.
balanceOf[_from] -= _value and allowance decrement performed without SafeMath (arithmetic risk outside the Solidity 0.5 checked domain).
total = _value * _tos.length computed with unchecked multiplication in batchSend.
Source address parameter of transferFrom.
Destination address parameter of transferFrom.
Amount parameter of transferFrom.
Target address parameter of delegate that is delegatecalled.
Calldata bytes parameter of delegate forwarded to delegatecall.
Array of recipient addresses parameter of batchSend.
Per-recipient amount parameter of batchSend.
Local variable in batchSend holding _value * _tos.length.
Loop-local recipient address inside batchSend.
Local computed Uniswap pair address inside ensure.

edges.reason: msg.sender is forwarded as the _from argument of transferFrom.
transfer delegates execution to transferFrom.
msg.sender is used as _from and as the spender whose allowance is checked and decremented.
transferFrom requires ensure(_from,_to,_value).
allowance[_from][msg.sender] is read and decremented in transferFrom.
balanceOf[_from] and balanceOf[_to] are mutated with unchecked arithmetic.
_onSaleNum[_from] is incremented on every transferFrom.
transferFrom contains unchecked balance subtraction.
Unsafe arithmetic directly modifies the balanceOf mapping.
ensure requires condition(_from,_value) for non-whitelisted senders.
owner is compared against _from/_to to bypass the sale condition.
tradeAddress is compared against _from to bypass the sale condition.
canSale[_from] whitelist bypasses the sale condition.
ensure calls pairFor to derive the whitelisted Uniswap pair.
_UNI local variable receives the pairFor result and is compared with _from.
condition reads _minSale to bound the transfer value.
condition reads _maxSale to bound the transfer value.
condition reads _saleNum to bound _onSaleNum[_from].
approve writes allowance[msg.sender][_spender].
msg.sender is the allowance owner in approve.
delegate executes an arbitrary delegatecall.
delegate requires msg.sender == owner before the delegatecall.
The delegatecall target address a is fully user-controlled.
The delegatecall payload bytes b is fully user-controlled.
init assigns _minSale from token.
init assigns _maxSale from maxToken.
init assigns _saleNum from saleNum.
init requires msg.sender == owner.
batchSend contains unchecked multiplication to compute total.
Unchecked multiplication consumes the _value parameter.
Unchecked multiplication consumes _tos.length.
batchSend stores _value * _tos.length in the local total.
batchSend requires msg.sender == owner.
balanceOf[msg.sender] is decremented by the unchecked total.
batchSend reads each loop-local recipient _to from _tos.
balanceOf[_to] is incremented for each batch recipient.
batchSend iterates over the _tos parameter array.
setTradeAddress writes the tradeAddress state variable.
setTradeAddress requires msg.sender == owner.
Constructor reads msg.sender as the initial owner and supply holder.
Constructor assigns owner = msg.sender.
Constructor sets totalSupply from _supply.
Constructor credits the entire supply into balanceOf[msg.sender].
Constructor grants the UNI router an unlimited allowance.
_msgSender returns the untrusted msg.sender value.
transferFrom declares and uses parameter _from.
transferFrom declares and uses parameter _to.
transferFrom declares and uses parameter _value.
delegate declares parameter a.
delegate declares parameter b.
batchSend declares parameter _tos.
batchSend declares parameter _value.
ensure declares the local variable _UNI.

normalization_plan.reason: _from is a transient input argument whose only role is to feed the transferFrom access-control checks and balance mutations.
_to is a transient recipient argument absorbed into the transferFrom state updates.
_value is a transient amount argument consumed by the allowance and balance logic of transferFrom.
the target address a exists solely to parameterize the unsafe delegatecall operation.
the calldata b is only meaningful as the payload of the unsafe delegatecall.
_tos is a transient array argument fully consumed by the batchSend loop.
the per-recipient amount argument is fully consumed by batchSend accounting.
total is a function-local temporary used only inside batchSend accounting.
the loop-local recipient is a temporary that only exists within batchSend.
_UNI is a function-local temporary computed and consumed only inside ensure.
